chunks: By this chain of transmission, from some of our companions who raised it (marfu') to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The sunnah has been established regarding istinja' with three virgin (unused) stones, and it is to be followed by water.

key_terms.أَبْكَارٍ: abkar — virgin, new, never previously used (of stones for cleansing)
key_terms.الِاسْتِنْجَاءِ: istinja' — ritual cleansing of the private parts after defecation or urination
key_terms.رَفَعَهُ: rafa'ahu — 'raised it'; technical hadith term (marfu') indicating attribution up the chain to the Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah method of istinja' according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This marfu' hadith, attributed to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) via an anonymous chain, prescribes the sunnah method for istinja' (ritual cleansing of the private parts after answering the call of nature): three virgin, previously unused stones, followed by water. The qualifier 'abkar' (virgin/new) stresses that the stones must be entirely clean and never employed for this purpose before, while the sequential use of stones then water reflects the comprehensive standard of taharah in Shia jurisprudence.
